channel.title: Majorca Daily Bulletin - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Majorca Daily Bulletin (majorcadailybulletin.com)

item.title: Great white sharks: when was the last confirmed sighting in Mallorca?
item.description: Between 1941 and 1976, at least 18 great white sharks were caught in Alcudia and Pollensa.

item.title: Britons face three year ban from Spain if caught by the 90-day trap
item.description: British nationals living in Spain do not need their passports to be stamped. Actively show your proof of residence, such as the foreigner’s identity card (‘la tarjeta de identidad de extranjero’ or ‘TIE’), when presenting your passport at Spanish border control.

item.title: Spain’s new law lets workers stay home - and still get paid - during extreme weather!
item.description: The climate permit covers extreme conditions like heavy snow, floods, strong winds, heatwaves, severe air pollution, or any weather that makes travel unsafe.

item.title: Britons in Mallorca could be offered travel lifeline as new passport rules launch
item.description: British dual nationals may be able to fly with Ryanair from Mallorca to Britain even if they do not have a current British passport when new immigration rules come into force next week, the airline has said. The airline is complying with controversial rules being introduced by the British government but has said that alternative documents that prove a person is a British national may be accepted, according to a report in The Guardian.

item.title: Soller sees August-like crowds in February as tourism surges in Mallorca
item.description: In recent years, local authorities have actively promoted policies to reduce seasonal tourism.

item.title: Ban on home purchases by non-residents in the Balearics goes to parliament; could be first law in Spain
item.description: ‘We have to prioritise that houses are for living in, for those who want to develop their life project in Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza or Formentera, and not for those who want to speculate and continue with this game of Monopoly that they have set up with our homes.’

item.title: Playa de Muro among the world’s top 12 beaches according to TripAdvisor
item.description: Alongside its global position, Playa de Muro also achieved sixth place among European beaches.

item.title: “We need to start getting used to a more tropical Mallorca - we can ease climate change but not stop it”
item.description: “The western Mediterranean, and specifically the Balearics, is a hotspot for climate change. Everything points to a future decrease in average rainfall and a clear increase in temperatures”

item.title: Mallorca weather for Thursday, February 19 - Yellow, amber warnings
item.description: Once Storm Pedro passes, the outlook is for much calmer weather.

item.title: Mallorca’s mission to control cat colonies
item.description: The new episode of the video series by German television journalist Sibylle Tiessen focuses on veterinary surgeon Miquela Cintes, who volunteers her time caring for feral cats.
